title: Expectation under a density
statement: Given a probability density $\\phi$ on $\\mathbb{F}_2^n$ and a function $g:\\mathbb{F}_2^n\\to\\mathbb{R}$, define the expectation of $g$ under $\\phi$ to be the uniform expectation of the product $x\\mapsto\\phi(x)g(x)$.
